title: Combo Damage Boost
description: Rewards taking less damage by making you deal more.
body: # Description Makes the first 5 hits of a combo increase your damage. First hit after taking damage: 1 Second hit in a row: 2 Goes up to 6 damage, which stays. It will reset when you get hit by anything. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames or scoreboard names. Changes the base attack damage of players.
